glosses: A scuzzy person, an unpleasant or disgusting person.

examples.text: For example, when the poor surviving father – the excellent actor Robert Forster as “Eddie Marino” – sees a pious liberal judge suspend the sentence on the scuz that killed his son, he goes berserk in the courtroom – and he ends up in the slammer for contempt of court!

glosses: A scuzzy thing, a disgusting substance, especially dirt or grime.
